verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents dev/staging/prod environments, per-environment flag states, or environment-scoped SDK keys. The closest items are adjacent features: target apps, which scope gates to applications within a project, and overrides for QA. Neither is environment separation, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage separate environments (dev/staging/prod) with independent flag states and scoped SDK keys
